fields.Name: W1 -> S9.3
fields.Description: Gate G0.6 (owner PR 2, phase 0, dataset W1, criterion S9.3): the user-facing strings of the Predictive Studio dashboard UI, Core and the story prompt templates make no causal claims, and 10 of 10 stories generated for the W1-signal s42 model make none. An LLM judge (the llm-judge oracle, strict) grades both against three criteria: features described only as associated or weighted, no claim that changing a feature changes the outcome, no advice to act on a feature. Needs AI_VENDOR_API_KEY__GeminiLLM (the story generator) and a judge model key.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The judge passes the UI/prompt strings and all 10 generated stories against the no-causal-claims criteria.
